rows.content: And may it be His will that there should be great success and the greatest success in all matters,
rows.sourceHebrew: ויה"ר אז מ'זאל האבן הצלחה רבה והצלחה הכי גדולה בכל הענינים,

rows.content: and in the manner of "and I will empty out for you a blessing until there is no more need."
